name: Quiet minimal
idea: One statement in a vast field and one object: calm, expensive, quiet.
brief: Quiet minimalism. One statement or one number per slide, placed with intent in a vast empty field (often off-centre, low or to one side). At most two blocks of content on any slide. Light hierarchy: the headline is large but light-weighted relative to the field; the text is small and spaced. An image, when present, is a single object on a plain ground, given room. Silence is the design: no rules, no frames, no texture.

styles: studio product photography, single object, plain seamless backdrop, soft light
soft 3D render of a single object on a plain ground
